title: Normative Deviation Modeling for EEG-based Depression Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.37338v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Web-enabled digital health services are expanding access to physiological monitoring and mental health screening. However, electroencephalography (EEG)-based major depressive disorder (MDD) detection remains challenging across heterogeneous data sources, where individual variability and acquisition differences may affect disease-related representations. In this work, we investigate the use of healthy normative references for EEG-based MDD detection. Specifically, structural and distributional reference models are independently trained using healthy control (HC) recordings to characterize departures from healthy EEG patterns. We develop two diagnostic approaches that incorporate normative deviations at different representation levels. Scalar-level Normative Deviation-guided Diagnosis (S-NDD) summarizes structural and distributional deviations into scalar scores and integrates them with deep EEG representations. translated_title: 面向基于脑电图的抑郁症检测的规范偏差建模
translated_abstract: 基于网络的数字健康服务正在扩大生理监测和心理健康筛查的可及性。然而，基于脑电图（EEG）的重度抑郁症（MDD）检测在异构数据源上仍然具有挑战性，其中个体差异和采集条件的不同可能会影响与疾病相关的表征。在本工作中，我们研究了利用健康规范参考进行基于EEG的MDD检测。具体而言，使用健康对照（HC）记录独立训练结构参考模型和分布参考模型，以刻画个体脑电偏离健康脑电模式的程度。我们开发了两种在不同表示层面引入规范偏差的诊断方法。标量级规范偏差引导诊断（S-NDD）将结构和分布偏差总结为标量分数，并将其与深度EEG表征相融合。特征级规范……（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出利用健康对照数据训练结构与分布参考模型来量化个体脑电偏离健康模式的规范偏差，并将其融入深度EEG表征，以提升跨异构数据源的抑郁症检测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes healthy normative reference models that quantify structural and distributional deviations from healthy EEG patterns and integrate them at scalar and feature levels to improve EEG-based depression detection across heterogeneous data sources.
